description: Serving backend for async jobs: job key helpers, strict pydantic job models, the DynamoDB-backed JobStore (generic Decimal-safe serialization + read-path projection + ConditionExpression-guarded writes), the shared serve-helpers refactor, and the submit (POST /jobs, 202 + Event-type lambda invoke) and worker (run_agent to completion + throttled progress + guaranteed terminal record) handlers, all with full unit tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (imports ProgressPhase and the on_progress callback). No CDK changes here — handlers are tested purely via dependency injection + moto.
steps: src/movieintel/persistence/keys.py: add `JOB_SK = "JOB"`, `def job_pk(job_id: str) -> str: return f"JOB#{job_id}"`, and `def job_sk() -> str: return JOB_SK` alongside the existing movie_pk/meta_sk helpers (design Decision 2 key schema).

Create src/movieintel/serving/jobs.py with strict (ConfigDict(extra='forbid')) models per design Decision 1 'New Pydantic models': JobStatus(StrEnum)=queued|running|succeeded|failed; reuse ProgressPhase from movieintel.agent.progress; JobProgress{phase: ProgressPhase, turn: int, label: str}; SubmitResponse{job_id: str, status: Literal['queued']='queued', poll_url: str}; WorkerError{error: Literal['worker_failed']='worker_failed', message: str}; NotFoundResponse{error: Literal['not_found']='not_found', message: str}; JobStatusResponse{job_id: str, status: JobStatus, progress: JobProgress (REQUIRED, non-optional), created_at: str, updated_at: str, result: AgentResult | None = None, error: WorkerError | None = None}. Import AgentResult from movieintel.agent.response and use it verbatim as the `result` field type (first alias-as-field use; pydantic v2 smart-union on disjoint kind, no TypeAdapter/discriminator). Do NOT flatten the nested WorkerError under `error` (design Finding 8). Serialize terminal bodies with exclude_none=True at the call site.

Create src/movieintel/serving/jobs_store.py: `import json, logging, time`; `from decimal import Decimal`; module `logger`. Add `JOB_TTL_SECONDS = 86400`. Add the generic `_to_dynamo(model: BaseModel) -> dict` (json.loads(json.dumps(model.model_dump(mode='json')), parse_float=Decimal)) and `_from_dynamo(raw: dict) -> dict` (json.loads(json.dumps(raw, default=float))) EXACTLY per design Decision 2 — self-contained, do NOT reuse repository _as_number/to_item. Add `class JobStore` taking `*, table, config: PersistenceConfig`.

Implement JobStore.create(*, job_id, query, max_turns): PutItem with PK=job_pk(job_id), SK=job_sk(), status='queued', a COMPLETE initial progress map {phase: understanding, turn: 0, label: PHASE_LABELS[understanding]}, query, optional max_turns (as a number when present), created_at=updated_at=now (ISO-8601 UTC 'Z'), expires_at=int(time.time())+JOB_TTL_SECONDS, ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(PK)'. Store the progress via _to_dynamo(JobProgress(...)).

Implement mark_running (SET status='running', updated_at), update_progress(job_id, progress: JobProgress) (SET progress=_to_dynamo(progress), updated_at — does NOT touch status), mark_succeeded(job_id, result: AgentResult) (SET status='succeeded', result=_to_dynamo(result), updated_at), mark_failed(job_id, error: WorkerError) (SET status='failed', error=_to_dynamo(error), updated_at). EVERY mutating method carries ConditionExpression='attribute_exists(PK) AND #s IN (:queued,:running)' with ExpressionAttributeNames {'#s':'status'}. A ConditionalCheckFailedException on update_progress is caught and swallowed at warning (progress is advisory); on a terminal mark it is tolerated (idempotent). mark_running is the SOLE owner of queued->running.

Implement JobStore.get(job_id) EXACTLY per design 'JobStore.get read-path projection': get_item(Key={PK,SK}); None when absent; else build an EXPLICIT PROJECTED payload = {job_id: job_id (from the ARG, not the item), status: item['status'], progress: _from_dynamo(item['progress']), created_at, updated_at}; conditionally add result=_from_dynamo(item['result']) and error=_from_dynamo(item['error']); return JobStatusResponse.model_validate(payload). Never validate the raw item (it carries PK/SK/query/max_turns/expires_at and no job_id).

Add tests/serving/test_jobs_store.py reusing tests/serving/conftest.py's moto table setup (build JobStore over the same moto MovieIntel table + persistence_config). Assert: create->get round-trip; mark_running flips status; after update_progress(JobProgress(phase=searching, turn=2, label=...)) get(job_id).progress.turn == 2 AND isinstance(..., int) (locks _from_dynamo on progress); get succeeds despite stored extras (projection + job_id reconstruction); mark_succeeded(job_id, RecommendationList(query_summary=..., movies=[RecommendedMovie(movie_id='1', title='A', sentiment=positive, pes=90.0, mood=uplifting, rationale='r')])) then get(job_id).result == original (alias-as-field + Decimal/float lossless proof, AC-4); expires_at present on the stored item; an update_progress AFTER a terminal mark is swallowed and status unchanged; get(unknown) is None.

Create the infra/handlers/shared package: add infra/handlers/shared/__init__.py if missing, and infra/handlers/shared/serving.py holding the reusable serve pieces factored out of infra/handlers/serve/handler.py: _JSON_HEADERS, _default_bedrock_client, _default_kb_client, _default_repository, _decode_body, _bad_request, _decode_error, _parse_request. Update infra/handlers/serve/handler.py to import these from handlers.shared.serving, re-binding the _default_* and _parse_request names into the serve module namespace so tests/serving/test_handler.py's monkeypatch of serve_module._default_bedrock_client / _default_kb_client / _default_repository still works. serve handler public behavior unchanged.

Create infra/handlers/submit/__init__.py and infra/handlers/submit/handler.py (handler string handlers.submit.handler.handler). Keyword-only DI signature mirroring serve, with optional job_store, lambda_client, config, persistence, kb_config defaulting to lazy builders (reuse handlers.shared.serving builders; build the DynamoDB Table + JobStore lazily; build the boto3 lambda client lazily). Dispatch per design Decision 1 'Route dispatch contract' checked in order: SUBMIT when routeKey=='POST /jobs' OR (requestContext.http.method=='POST' AND path=='/jobs'); POLL when routeKey=='GET /jobs/{id}' OR (method=='GET' AND path.startswith('/jobs/')); else 404 NotFoundResponse. SUBMIT: _parse_request (reused; 400 ValidationErrorResponse on bad/undecodable body, NO record + NO invoke, same except chain as serve); job_id = uuid4().hex; JobStore.create(...) BEFORE invoke; lambda_client.invoke(FunctionName=os.environ['WORKER_FUNCTION_NAME'], InvocationType='Event', Payload=json.dumps({'job_id','query','max_turns'}).encode()); on invoke exception -> mark_failed(WorkerError(message='could not start worker')) and STILL return 202; on create exception -> 500 {'error':'submit_failed','message':...} logged at exception; return 202 SubmitResponse{job_id,'queued',poll_url=f'/jobs/{job_id}'}. POLL: id from event['pathParameters']['id'] else fallback path.rstrip('/').rsplit('/',1)[-1]; empty/missing -> 404; JobStore.get(id) -> None=404 NotFoundResponse, found=200 JobStatusResponse (exclude_none=True), RAISES -> 500 {'error':'poll_failed','message':...} logged at error. Module logger.

Create infra/handlers/worker/__init__.py and infra/handlers/worker/handler.py (handler string handlers.worker.handler.handler) per design Decision 3 worker sketch. Keyword-only DI signature with optional client/repository/kb_client/config/persistence/kb_config/job_store defaulting to the shared lazy builders. Read job_id/query/max_turns from the trusted event (missing job_id -> log + return, nothing to write). Call job_store.mark_running(job_id). Build on_progress as a (phase, turn)-throttled closure over job_store+job_id that calls job_store.update_progress(JobProgress(phase=event.phase, turn=event.turn, label=event.label)) on the first event OR whenever the incoming (phase, turn) differs from the last written pair. Call run_agent(query, client=..., repository=..., kb_client=..., kb_config=..., config=..., max_turns=max_turns or MAX_TURNS, on_progress=on_progress); then job_store.mark_succeeded(job_id, result). Wrap the body in `try/except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001` (the ONE allowed broad catch) that logs at exception and calls job_store.mark_failed(job_id, WorkerError(message='unexpected error running the agent')). Return {'job_id': job_id}. Module logger.
Add tests/serving/conftest.py FakeLambdaClient: a small double recording each invoke(**kwargs) call (FunctionName, InvocationType, decoded Payload) without invoking; export it in __all__.

Add tests/serving/test_submit_handler.py (reusing moto_repository + a JobStore over it): assert the 202 body shape (job_id is 32-char hex, status=='queued', poll_url==f'/jobs/{job_id}'); a queued record is created BEFORE invoke and exactly one InvocationType='Event' invoke recorded with matching job_id/query/max_turns; 400 on a bad body (no record, no invoke); invoke-failure path (FakeLambdaClient.invoke raises) marks failed + still returns 202; route dispatch (POST /jobs event -> submit; GET /jobs/{id} event in BOTH routeKey and resolved-path forms -> poll + id extracted; mismatch -> 404); GET poll returns the stored record / 404 for unknown id / 500 poll_failed when an injected JobStore.get raises. AC-1,2,3,4,5,6.

Add tests/serving/test_worker_handler.py (reusing moto_repository + a JobStore over it + a scripted CapturingConverseClient): assert a successful run writes 'succeeded' with the right result; progress was written on (phase, turn) change (inspect the store / written progress); a deliberately-raising injected converse client yields a 'failed' record and NO escaped exception (FR-4/AC-9).
acceptance_criteria: `uv run pytest tests/serving/test_jobs_store.py tests/serving/test_submit_handler.py tests/serving/test_worker_handler.py` passes, including the Decimal/int progress.turn assertion, the RecommendationList-with-float-pes result round-trip, the submit 202/400/invoke-failure paths, the route-dispatch rules, and the worker success + crash-to-failed paths.
`uv run pytest tests/serving/test_handler.py` passes UNCHANGED after the shared-module refactor (serve handler behavior and its monkeypatch targets preserved) — AC-10.
`uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .`, and `uv run mypy src` (and a local `uv run mypy` covering infra) pass.
verification: uv run pytest tests/serving/test_jobs_store.py tests/serving/test_submit_handler.py tests/serving/test_worker_handler.py tests/serving/test_handler.py tests/agent
findings: Public API for downstream FEATs. KEYS (movieintel.persistence.keys): JOB_SK='JOB'; job_pk(job_id)->'JOB#<job_id>'; job_sk()->'JOB'. MODELS (movieintel.serving.jobs, all extra='forbid'): JobStatus(StrEnum)=queued|running|succeeded|failed; JobProgress{phase: ProgressPhase, turn: int, label: str}; SubmitResponse{job_id, status: Literal['queued']='queued', poll_url}; WorkerError{error: Literal['worker_failed']='worker_failed', message}; NotFoundResponse{error: Literal['not_found']='not_found', message}; JobStatusResponse{job_id, status: JobStatus, progress: JobProgress (REQUIRED), created_at, updated_at, result: AgentResult|None=None, error: WorkerError|None=None}. JobStatusResponse embeds AgentResult (PEP695 alias) VERBATIM as the result field; pydantic v2 smart-union on disjoint kind validates it (no TypeAdapter/discriminator) and round-trips losslessly. FEAT-004 (OpenAPI) harvests these via model_json_schema(); a failed body INTENTIONALLY nests WorkerError under top-level error (do not flatten). STORE (movieintel.serving.jobs_store): JOB_TTL_SECONDS=86400; JobStore(*, table, config: PersistenceConfig). Methods: create(*, job_id, query, max_turns) (PutItem, ConditionExpression attribute_not_exists(PK), writes COMPLETE understanding/0 progress + expires_at=int(time.time())+TTL); mark_running (SOLE queued->running owner); update_progress(job_id, JobProgress) (SET progress+updated_at ONLY, never status; a ConditionalCheck failure is swallowed at warning); mark_succeeded(job_id, AgentResult); mark_failed(job_id, WorkerError) (both terminal, idempotent-tolerant). EVERY mutating method carries ConditionExpression 'attribute_exists(PK) AND #s IN (:queued,:running)'. get(job_id) returns None|JobStatusResponse via an EXPLICIT PROJECTED payload (job_id from the ARG, progress/result/error each through _from_dynamo) - NEVER validates the raw item. Self-contained generic serializers _to_dynamo (model.model_dump(mode='json')->json->parse_float=Decimal) / _from_dynamo (json dump default=float -> reload) - do NOT reuse repository _as_number/to_item. SHARED HELPERS (infra/handlers/shared/serving.py, package __init__ added): _JSON_HEADERS, _default_bedrock_client/_default_kb_client/_default_repository, _decode_body, _bad_request, _decode_error, _parse_request - factored out of serve/handler.py. serve/handler.py now imports them and re-binds the names so tests/serving/test_handler.py's monkeypatch of serve_module._default_* still works (serve behavior unchanged). SUBMIT handler (infra/handlers/submit/handler.py, string handlers.submit.handler.handler): keyword-only DI (job_store, lambda_client, config, persistence, kb_config) defaulting to lazy builders (_default_job_store builds boto3 Table+JobStore; _default_lambda_client builds boto3 lambda). Dispatch order: _is_submit_request (routeKey=='POST /jobs' OR method POST + path=='/jobs') -> _submit; _is_poll_request (routeKey=='GET /jobs/{id}' OR method GET + path.startswith('/jobs/')) -> _poll; else 404. _submit: _parse_request (reused; 400 ValidationErrorResponse, no record/no invoke); job_id=uuid4().hex; JobStore.create BEFORE invoke; lambda invoke InvocationType='Event', Payload json {job_id,query,max_turns} from os.environ['WORKER_FUNCTION_NAME']; invoke exception -> mark_failed(WorkerError('could not start worker')) + STILL 202; create exception -> 500 {'error':'submit_failed'} logged exception; success -> 202 SubmitResponse(poll_url=f'/jobs/{job_id}'). _poll: id from pathParameters['id'] else path.rstrip('/').rsplit('/',1)[-1]; empty->404; get None->404 NotFoundResponse('no job with that id'); found->200 JobStatusResponse exclude_none=True; get RAISES->500 {'error':'poll_failed'} logged error. WORKER handler (infra/handlers/worker/handler.py, string handlers.worker.handler.handler): keyword-only DI (client/repository/kb_client/config/persistence/kb_config/job_store). Missing job_id -> log + return {'job_id': None}. mark_running then run_agent(..., max_turns=max_turns or MAX_TURNS, on_progress=_progress_writer) then mark_succeeded; body wrapped in the ONE allowed `except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001` logging exception + mark_failed(WorkerError('unexpected error running the agent')); returns {'job_id': job_id}. _progress_writer is a (phase,turn)-throttled closure (writes on first event OR when (phase.value,turn) differs from last) calling job_store.update_progress. TESTS (tests/serving): FakeLambdaClient added to conftest.py (records invoke kwargs FunctionName/InvocationType/decoded-Payload; raise_on_invoke flag; in __all__) + a moto_job_store fixture (JobStore over the same moto MovieIntel table schema). test_jobs_store.py, test_submit_handler.py, test_worker_handler.py all pass. VERIFICATION: ruff check . + ruff format --check . + mypy (local, all paths) clean; the FEAT-002 pytest set (test_jobs_store/test_submit_handler/test_worker_handler/test_handler/tests/agent) = 86 passed; test_handler.py UNCHANGED. Full `uv run pytest` = 340 passed, 3 skipped, 17 failed - the 17 are the PRE-EXISTING _sqlite-absent failures in tests/data_access + test_extract_handler (NOT regressions). To run pytest locally the session-scoped autouse _require_real_dbs fixture needs _sqlite/movies.db + _sqlite/ratings.db to exist (empty files suffice for stub-only suites; they are gitignored - create then delete; the _sqlite-dependent suites still fail on empty files, as on base). NO CDK/infra_stack/openapi/frontend/docs changes here (those are FEAT-003/004/005). AgentResult/RecommendedMovie enum members are UPPERCASE (Sentiment.POSITIVE, Mood.UPLIFTING).
